news.title: ‘Wow, it’s a real discovery’: Claude cracks a 25-year NSA number mystery
news.summary: Numbers the spy agency handed over in the 1990s, long suspected of hiding a backdoor, turn out to have come from a basic computer program. Bitcoin was never on that list, and its quantum problem hasn’t gone anywhere.

news.title: Satoshi-era bitcoin faces a bigger quantum threat after Google’s new Willow breakthrough
news.summary: Google says its Willow chip can prepare the special quantum states needed for advanced calculations with about 40 times fewer errors, reducing one of the hardware bottlenecks behind any future attempt to crack bitcoin wallets.

news.title: Big Tech's AI auditors will only see what they're shown
news.summary: If the White House accord's audits are going to be worth anything, auditors should be able to choose what they test, writes Samuel Vance-Law, head of research at the Decentralization Research Center.

news.title: Traders will soon be able to bet on whether Coinbase, Robinhood and Marathon will hit their targets
Circle targets 40 new markets as stablecoin demand grows globally
news.summary: The stablecoin issuer’s CEO Jerermy Allaire told Reuters demand for digital dollars is growing across Asia, Africa and Latin America as banks and payment firms.

news.title: Quantum Alliance forms amid warnings 6.4 million bitcoin face future quantum threat
news.summary: Nine crypto companies launched the Quantum Alliance to jointly prepare for quantum attacks, but they disagree on when the threat will arrive and whether vulnerable BTC should be frozen.

news.title: Tokenized Tesla surges as Elon Musk unveils SpaceX-powered flying Roadster prototype
news.summary: Volume in Hyperliquid’s Tesla contract hit $47 million in one hour after Elon Musk’s flying Roadster demo, up from $2.8 million, with U.S. stocks closed.

news.title: Altcoins outpace bitcoin as celestia jumps 16%, Warsh silent on interest-rate plans
news.summary: Celestia jumped 16%, injective rose 7.7% and layerzero added 7.3% while bitcoin held little changed near $82,100 and Fed Chair Warsh gave no sign on interest rates.

news.title: I’m 63 and diagnosed with lymphoma. Should I take my Social Security next year?
news.summary: “My plan is to continue working as long as I’m able to do so and invest my Social Security benefits while I’m still earning a paycheck.”

news.title: Fed interest-rate decision this month is a closer call than markets think
news.summary: Here are some of the arguments against a Fed rate hike — and why some economists disagree with them.

news.title: Nowhere to hide: Tech selloff hits software and chip stocks alike
news.summary: The software and semiconductor sectors haven’t been trading in tandem much this year, but they collectively fell Friday as AI and interest-rate fears hit the market.

news.title: This Senate race where data centers are a crucial issue has more spending than any other midterm clash
news.summary: Money is pouring in and funding intense, negative ads: “It’s everywhere, and you can’t escape it.”

news.title: Could an Anthropic IPO put your 401(k) at risk? The AI safety debate hits a new dimension.
news.summary: Anthropic and New York City’s comptroller have opened a line of communication to discuss “existential risks” posed by AI and what that could mean for the company’s future stock.

news.title: The bond market shrugged off two inflation shocks. Why stock investors should pay attention.
news.summary: Hot CPI and PPI data should have pushed Treasury yields higher. Instead, bond buyers stepped in to suggest yields have risen high enough to become attractive for investors.

news.title: New SEC rules would fleece everyday investors to enrich Wall Street
news.summary: New proposals from the Securities and Exchange Commission will tilt the scales in favor of Wall Street and against a huge group of retail investors.
